newsitem.title: USA: Wash. 1,158 MW nuclear unit outage delayed.
newsitem.headline: Wash. 1,158 MW nuclear unit outage delayed.

text.p: The 1,158 megawatt (MW) WNP-2 nuclear power unit will begin its annual outage the week of March 17 rather than this week, a spokesman for the plant said Wednesday.
The plant was expected to shut this week due to an oversupply of low-cost hydropower in the Northwest.
But the Bonneville Power Administration (BPA), which has seen power supplies throughout the West tighten and spot power prices rise sharply this week, requested the delay.
WNP-2 operations have fluctuated since early January due to problems with the speed drive as well as BPA's supply needs.

Until the outage starts, WNP-2 will operate at full power during weekdays, but will power down to 70 percent during the night and early morning hours and to 55 percent on weekends, the spokesman said.
